title: Meridian Defense Systems C2 Platform Program: Weekly Status Report
report:
Meridian Defense Systems C2 Platform Program: Weekly Status Report
Report date: 2026-09-23

MILESTONES & RISKS

Authority to Operate (ATO) Approval is trending late, now forecast for 2026-10-14 against a planned date of 2026-09-30, driven by the cybersecurity ATO documentation package that has been blocked since 2026-09-10 pending ISSO review, with the ISSO office informally signaling a possible 2-3 week slip.

The radar feed adapter integration, a dependency for Critical Design Review completion, is roughly 11 days overdue due to incomplete vendor API documentation, with engineering notes warning of a possible additional week or more of delay, while the CDR forecast date of 2026-11-15 remains unadjusted. The reported "On Track" status needs to be corrected to At Risk (or similar) until the integration delay is resolved or the CDR date is reassessed. RISK-021 (subcontractor staffing gap on fusion engine team) is Closed and can be removed from the risk registrar.

The Customer Demo / IOC Readiness Review is roughly two months out, with preparatory work just beginning: the software test plan update is in progress and due 2026-09-24, while customer-requested dry-run logistics are not yet scheduled and due 2026-10-01. No task is overdue and no risk is currently linked to this milestone, so there is no evidence of schedule pressure at this time. The reported "Not Started" status should be corrected, since the linked test plan update task is already in progress.

ATO.name: Authority to Operate (ATO) Approval
ATO.status: ATO Approval is on track to miss its planned 2026-09-30 date, now forecast for 2026-10-14. The driver is the cybersecurity ATO documentation package, which has been blocked since its 2026-09-10 due date pending ISSO review, and the ISSO office has informally indicated a possible 2-3 week slip past the original target.
ATO.explanation: The reported 'At Risk' status is consistent with the evidence: the linked documentation task is overdue and blocked, and the linked risk (RISK-014, High/High) is open and describes the same ISSO review delay. Engineering notes corroborate this with an informal 2-3 week slip estimate, which aligns with the forecast date moving from 9/30 to 10/14. One inconsistency to note: the risk register has not been updated to reflect the specific slip estimate mentioned informally in the notes, though this does not change the current risk rating or the milestone status. No resource conflict was identified for this milestone, as the blocked task has no named assignee; the R. Chen staffing concern noted in engineering notes applies to CDR, not this milestone.

CDR.name: Critical Design Review (CDR)
CDR.status: The radar feed adapter integration task, a dependency for CDR completion, was due 2026-09-12 and remains In Progress as of 2026-09-23, roughly 11 days overdue, with engineering notes citing incomplete vendor API documentation and a possible additional week or more of delay. The planned/forecast CDR date remains 2026-11-15 with no adjustment reflecting this slip.
CDR.explanation: The 'On Track' status does not accurately reflect the evidence: the radar feed adapter task is overdue and engineering notes explicitly tie it to CDR as a dependency, warning the milestone could be pushed. The status should be changed to At Risk (or similar) until the integration delay is resolved or the CDR date is reassessed. Additionally, RISK-009 (radar adapter integration) is still marked 'Monitoring' with Medium/Medium ratings and has not been updated to reflect the current vendor documentation gap or the task's slipped due date, an inconsistency between the risk register and the task tracker/notes, though this does not itself change the flag.
